title: SG-11 Drive character animations and scene transition from game actions
summary: React game actions must trigger the Phaser character interact animation and the scene transition
description: Context: BootScene already plays the character idle loop on create, plays interact then idle when a character sprite is clicked, and plays the authored fade once in create(). ReactToPhaserEvents already declares playAnimation and transitionTo, but nothing emits or handles them, so game actions such as object actions and dialogue choices never reach the Phaser scene. Desired behavior: performing a game action in the app screen makes the boy play the interact animation and then return to idle, and a scene change replays the scene transition, all through the Phaser scene. Expected result: unit tests confirm interact and transition are triggered from game actions. Why: the app screen should visibly react to gameplay.
acceptance_criteria: Given the BootScene is created, when a playAnimation event targets a character, then that character sprite plays the named animation and returns to idle
Given the app is playing, when an object action is performed, then a playAnimation interact event is emitted for the boy
Given the BootScene is created, when a transitionTo event is received, then the scene transition is played through the Phaser scene
Given a game action that moves the scene, when it is performed, then a transitionTo event is emitted

in_scope: BootScene subscription to playAnimation and transitionTo
App emitting those events from game actions
preserve: Existing click-to-interact behavior on character sprites
Idle animation on create and the transition on create
Typed event bus contracts for existing events

technical_constraints: Phaser 3.90 with Phaser mocked in unit tests
Use the existing reactToPhaser bus and event types in game/frontend/src/phaser/events.ts
definition_of_done: Requirements implemented with unit tests passing
Events are unsubscribed on scene shutdown
non_functional: No Phaser listener leaks after scene shutdown
